verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents broad framework support (Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, Hono, '20+ more') and provides `auth.api` server-side methods to authenticate/verify sessions, which implies route-protection capability across frameworks, and community testimony confirms multi-framework portability (e.g. migrating Next.js→Hono with minimal changes). However, the evidence never explicitly documents a dedicated Next.js middleware helper or edge-runtime session verification pattern. Missing for 10: explicit docs/example of Next.js middleware.ts protecting routes, confirmation of edge-runtime compatibility (e.g. Vercel Edge Functions), and equivalent middleware guidance for other framework peers.
